title: Game Design & Technical Bible
subtitle: Every screen, every number, every system - and everything that still needs fixing
engine: Vanilla JavaScript + Three.js, no build step
author: Legendterra
note: This book is the reference for the next development passes. Part V is a numbered issue register: every entry names the file, the evidence, and the fix, so a later pass can work from it without re-reading the codebase. The Status column was refreshed in v5.2.1, which closed the second elemental-darkness bug (BUG-023), made ropes and ladders hang from what they are tied to (BUG-024), and rebuilt the HUD around a single measured layout table (BUG-025).
